sections.text:
-Target: 1 random enemy out of all enemies. Ability Power 460. Success value 100. 10x physical damage (Star).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Increases physical and magic Ability Power of damage taken by 40 for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases physical and magic attack Ability Power by 80 for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases Ability Power buff limit for physical attacks by 40 for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases Ability Power buff limit for magic attacks by 40 for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Cost recovery speed reduced by 5 for 30 seconds. [Demerit]
-Target: yourself. Applies Protection for 90 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; increases DEF and MDEF by 100%; nullifies status ailments, debuffs, and buff removal effects. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 11000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 11000
